card.name: Final piece of new brand drug names
card.fires_on: The last piece of a newly coined brand drug name, such as the VI, LI or Y ending names like KYGEVVI, LIVMARLI, ZEGFROVY and ZOKINVY, in prescribing-information text.

modes.label: Brand name ending
modes.description: The closing letters of an invented capitalized brand name used as the drug in dosing or warning sentences.

card.writes: It adds little clear meaning; the promoted tokens look like unrelated word endings.
